ai_summary: A playful animated button component that simulates a wet paint dripping effect using Framer Motion. Features multiple drip elements with continuous wobbling animations and smooth color transitions on hover from indigo-500 to indigo-600. The button uses Tailwind CSS for styling and includes SVG clip paths for realistic drip curvature. Ideal for creative interfaces, landing pages, and design-focused applications requiring visual interest.
